question: Which of the following was a military division during the reign of Alauddin Khalji?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Diwan-e-Arz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Diwan-e-Arz** was a significant department introduced during the reign of **Alauddin Khalji**, a ruler of the Delhi Sultanate. It was primarily established to oversee and manage all military affairs of the Sultanate.
 
• The department ensured the proper functioning of the army, including recruitment, training, and payment of soldiers, as well as the maintenance of military equipment and resources.
 
• The **Diwan-e-Arz** was headed by an officer known as the **Ariz-i-Mamalik**, who was responsible for reviewing and organizing the army, ensuring its efficiency and readiness for wars and expeditions.
 
• This department was crucial during Alauddin Khalji's reign as he focused on military expansion and strengthening the defense system of his empire. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• Other departments like **Diwan-e-Insha**, **Diwan-e-Wizarat**, and **Diwan-e-Risalat** dealt with administration, finance, and religious affairs, respectively, and were not directly related to military functions. *Thus, these options are incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Diwan-e-Arz:**

 
 
• This department played a significant role in maintaining the Sultanate's military strength and ensuring order among the soldiers.
 
• The **Ariz-i-Mamalik**, who was the head of the department, had the authority to inspect the army and ensure the soldiers were properly equipped and disciplined.
 
• The department supervised the payment of salaries to soldiers and maintained a record of their service to prevent corruption and irregularities.
 
 
 
• **Other Departments:**
 
 
• **Diwan-e-Insha:** This department handled the royal correspondence and communication. It was responsible for drafting and recording royal decrees and letters.
 
• **Diwan-e-Wizarat:** Also known as the finance department, this department was responsible for managing the state's revenues, collecting taxes, and maintaining records of income and expenditure.
 
• **Diwan-e-Risalat:** This department dealt with religious and diplomatic affairs. It was responsible for maintaining relations with foreign states and looking after religious endowments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Military Reforms Under Alauddin Khalji:**

 
 
• Alauddin Khalji introduced several reforms to strengthen the military system of the Delhi Sultanate. He established a permanent standing army and made significant efforts to control the feudal lords.
 
• The salaries of soldiers were paid in cash, and a system of branding horses and maintaining descriptive rolls of soldiers, known as **dagh** and **chehra**, was introduced to prevent corruption.
 
• He also ensured that the prices of essential commodities were kept low to enable soldiers to sustain themselves with their salaries.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Military:**
 
 
• The military was a cornerstone of Alauddin Khalji's administration and played a critical role in expanding and maintaining his empire. The introduction of the **Diwan-e-Arz** ensured that the military functioned efficiently and effectively.
 
• The emphasis on military reforms and administrative efficiency helped Alauddin Khalji consolidate his power and defend his empire against external threats, including the Mongols.
